risks.risk: Console may not be PS4 Pro (could be PS4 Slim/other variant), which changes value.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the console rear model label/serial sticker showing the exact model (CUH-xxxx) and a photo of the front/side for visual confirmation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case match you can confirm from photos: treat as a generic PS4 console without Pro confirmation.

risks.risk: Functionality risk: HDMI/USB/controller ports may be faulty even if it looks clean.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip: power on + HDMI display showing the home screen, then plug/unplug a USB device and test at least one USB port and both controller buttons.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working (worst case: assume ports/controllers may need repair).

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issue risk (fan noise, shutdowns, dust).
risks.proof: Ask for a 10–15 minute gameplay or system stress clip showing it stays on without shutdown and fan behavior is normal.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential overheating risk (worst case: assume it may overheat).

risks.risk: Accessories authenticity/quantity risk (pads count, cables, and whether controllers are included and working).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing all included items laid out (console, both controllers if claimed, cables) with a close-up of controller model numbers and a quick controller pairing/response clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal confirmed accessories only (worst case: fewer/unknown condition controllers).

risks.risk: Receipt/region claim risk (UK receipt may be missing; region mismatch can affect availability of some content).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the UK receipt (with sensitive details covered) and the console region/model label.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the console rear model label (CUH-xxxx) to confirm PS4 Pro vs Slim (photo).
Video: power on to the PS4 home screen via HDMI (functional proof).
Video: test USB ports (plug a USB drive) and confirm controller buttons/joysticks respond.
10–15 minute gameplay/stress clip to show no overheating/shutdown.
Photo of all included items laid out (controllers, cables, pads) and a close-up of controller model numbers; plus a photo of the UK receipt if it exists.
response.reason: The photo does not confirm the exact PS4 model (Pro vs Slim) and provides no functional proof for ports, overheating, or included accessories; without these, a safe worst-case price cannot be chosen from the comparables.
